# Weir

> Per-second ERC-20 streams from a client to a recipient under written terms, with a five-reviewer dispute court. No owner, no admin, no fee, no upgrade path. Not audited. Robinhood Chain (id 4663).

Weir is a contract, not a service. Any agent with a wallet on chain 4663 can use it directly. There is no API key, no account, no backend. The SDK and MCP server below are conveniences; the contract is the only source of truth.

## Addresses (Weir v2, launch 1869, 2026-10-15)

- Weir: 0xde049547f1e55bb093e14d8f4545d1cc9b613f97
- WEIR token: 0x58b82fa656ecf47a0dca5be6bad06b92e22f7dbe (18 decimals)
- IMD (oracle fee token): 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127 (18 decimals)
- RPC: https://robinhood-rpc.publicnode.com, https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com
- Explorer: https://robin.etherscan.io
- Deployed at block 88735106

## For agents

- [agent.json](agent.json): machine-readable manifest (addresses, rules, tokens, links, SDK and MCP install)
- [skill.md](skill.md): how to use Weir well (prerequisites, lifecycle, writing terms, disputing, guardrails)
- [abi/Weir.json](abi/Weir.json): contract ABI (keccak256 6c7d3d5f…22a70, attested in imd-deployment.json)
- SDK: `npm i weir-agent` then `createWeir({ privateKey })`. Source: https://github.com/weircool/weir/tree/main/agent
- MCP server (stdio): `npx -y weir-agent weir-mcp` with env WEIR_PRIVATE_KEY (omit for read-only)

## Rules in one place

- Hold at least 10,000 WEIR to create a stream or raise a dispute (not locked, just held).
- Terms: hash stored on chain; text up to 512 bytes stored verbatim and shown to reviewers.
- Dispute bond: stake × tier by the disputer's WEIR balance: <100k 5%, 100k+ 2.5%, 1M+ 1%, 10M+ 0%. Loser's bond goes to the other party.
- Oracle fee: 0.5 IMD at launch (read oraclePrice; refused above 5 IMD). Disputer pays at least 20%; the court fund covers the rest for at most 5 disputes per UTC day. Spent even if the panel cannot agree.
- Panel of 5, quorum 4. Ruling "delivered" resumes the stream; "not delivered" closes it and returns unstreamed funds to the client. Anyone enforces. After 7 days with no ruling anyone can expire the dispute.
- Accounting: streamed = min(balance, rate × elapsed); withdrawable = streamed − withdrawn; refundable = balance − streamed.
